name: Listenling · Gremlet #41
description:
A machine with a listening dish on its head. It was built to hear far-off signals; now it mostly listens to birdsong.

One of 50 one-of-a-kind Gremlets. Owning this token unlocks Listenling in the Gremlets desktop app, where it walks on your windows, naps, plays with other Gremlets and shows off its signature move.
